summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Mod Syndicate app. Backend: All 20/20 API tests passing. Frontend: All critical user flows tested and working including registration, onboarding, marketplace, product detail, garage, booking flow, community, and contact form. Fixed 1 backend bug (MongoDB ObjectId serialization in garage endpoint).

fixed_bugs.issue: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error - returned 500 when adding product to garage
